subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Should the remaining WhatsApp final-error delivery slice be handled as a revived narrow WhatsApp patch, or only through the broader cross-channel durable fallback contract?
rationale: The source-level bug remains, but the original narrow WhatsApp PR is closed unmerged while a maintainer-authored broad contract issue remains open; choosing the repair sequence is an owner/product decision.

options.title: Revive Narrow WhatsApp Patch
options.body: Reopen or replace the closed WhatsApp delivery PR so final sanitized error payloads reach WhatsApp while broader conformance remains tracked separately.

options.title: Only Broad Contract
options.body: Leave the WhatsApp slice to the cross-channel final-fallback contract issue, accepting that this concrete incident stays unresolved until that larger work lands.

options.title: Fold Into Lane-Release PR
options.body: Ask maintainers to expand the current open Codex lane-release PR to also handle WhatsApp final fallback delivery, increasing scope but reducing open work items.

recommendation.title: Revive Narrow WhatsApp Patch
recommendation.body: Reopen or replace the closed WhatsApp delivery PR so final sanitized error payloads reach WhatsApp while broader conformance remains tracked separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to osolmaz and osolmaz owns the broader final fallback delivery contract discussion that controls the sequencing choice.
